reports.headline: Nifty +0.63%, FII +₹7,284 Cr, Brent $94.62
points: Nifty closed Wednesday at 23,960.60 (+0.63%). GIFT Nifty was 24,309.50 at 07:21 IST, 348.90 points above it (one source).

Brent settled at $94.62 (-8.67%). Early Thursday: Kospi -3.6%, Nikkei -0.39% (Business Standard).

points: Nifty closed Tuesday at 23,810.85 (+1.58%). GIFT Nifty was 23,725 at 03:01 AM IST, 85.85 points below it (one source).
